description: 台灣中油公司各項油品牌價 [fuel stations and oil] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 台灣中油股份有限公司. （1)提供最新即時牌價，包含中油主產品牌價、中油天然氣牌價、中油燃料油牌價、航空燃油牌價、國內線海運燃油牌價。 (2)液化石油氣牌價自2020年12月份後，配合政府政策價格未調整。 （3)各項油品歷史牌價置於本公司全球資訊網。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 台灣中油股份有限公司. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-10-09 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
